# Verso

> Verso is a free, open source content management system (CMS) built on Laravel 13. It is a modern alternative to WordPress: a visual page and theme builder, SEO tools, forms, a shop, newsletters, memberships, roles and permissions, and an admin in 15 languages ship in one install. MIT licensed.

- Requirements: PHP 8.4 or newer; SQLite, MySQL or PostgreSQL.
- Stack: Laravel 13, Inertia 3, React 19, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Tiptap, Blade themes.
- Install: `composer create-project victoragudo/verso my-site`, or upload the release zip (dependencies included), then follow the web install wizard.
- Updates: signed releases on GitHub; sites check daily and can update automatically.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/victoragudo/verso/blob/main/docs/README.md): every guide in one list.
- [Theme guide](https://github.com/victoragudo/verso/blob/main/docs/THEME-GUIDE.md): build a theme without code, as a child theme or from scratch.
- [Extending Verso](https://github.com/victoragudo/verso/blob/main/docs/EXTENDING.md): plugins, blocks, capabilities and registries.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/victoragudo/verso/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the modules fit together.
- [Releasing](https://github.com/victoragudo/verso/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md): CI, releases and how sites update.
